outcome: Gastrointestinal (GI) microbiota composition (diversity, specific bacterial groups like Enterobacteriaceae, Bifidobacterium)
cohort: The study included 37 pairs of premature and term infants.
finding: The faecal microbiota differed greatly between infants born at term and those born prematurely during early life (6 weeks) but converged to a similar, more adult-like state by 2 years, with early clinical factors (including prematurity and delivery method) remaining significantly associated with specific bacterial groups and linked to childhood wheeze and eczema.
mod_finding: Delivery method was identified as a clinical factor that remained associated with components of the gut microbiota at 2 years of age.
